description: Fateh Sports Wear Limited is a garment exporter listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange, with its plant and head office at Plot 442, Mirpurkhas Road, Hyderabad. The company manufactures knitted apparel and readymade garments for export, and its stated vision is to remain a leading exporter of readymade garments and a globally competitive centre of production.
